sections.overview: This marine Liparidae snailfish is known from Isla Guadalupe, Mexico.
sections.identification: The description notes a pale body, with a dark tongue and palate.
sections.habitat: It has been collected in midwater over deep seafloor near the island.
sections.diet: The consulted accounts do not report its diet.
sections.behavior: Species-specific behavior is not documented in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted sources give no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The original material was very limited, so its ecology remains poorly known. P. pallidus is another eastern-Pacific congener recorded off Baja California; its description emphasizes pale coloration, unlike the dark mouth parts noted here.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists the species as not evaluated by the IUCN.
